name: antigravity
description: Google Antigravity coding CLI resource (binary `agy`): a thin Go entrypoint wiring lifecycle, an upstream update-check, and shared command-permission governance. Optional external-cli; sudo-free install; on-disk state backed up. NOT wired as an agent-manager runner (deferred follow-up).

settings.rationale: Shared Gemini/Antigravity global settings (selected auth type, preview toggles) read by the agy CLI and the Antigravity 2.0 desktop app.

oauth.rationale: Google OAuth credentials (access/refresh tokens) — live secrets; back up only deliberately. Restoring stale tokens can break auth; re-run `agy` sign-in instead.

accounts.rationale: Active/old Google account identifiers bound to the OAuth session — back up deliberately alongside the credentials.

cli_settings.rationale: Antigravity CLI configuration: model, toolPermission mode, trustedWorkspaces, and the native `permissions` allow/deny/ask grants. Hand-tuned operator state.

cli_conversations.rationale: Antigravity CLI conversation transcripts (one SQLite .db per thread) — the primary CLI conversation record for later analysis.

cli_memory.rationale: Antigravity CLI cross-session memory and per-conversation transcripts/state (brain/<id>/) carried across sessions.

cli_knowledge.rationale: Antigravity CLI knowledge base (user knowledge items the agent retrieves across sessions).

desktop_state.rationale: Antigravity 2.0 desktop app agent state under the shared home: conversation transcripts (conversations/*.pb) and memory (brain/). Excludes the sibling antigravity-browser-profile/ (regenerable Chromium cache).
